# Base text

Every key of the game's English text, with its message. A mod gives a key new text in `i18n/en/<file>.json`; see [Limits](limits.md). An override keeps the base message's arguments, each of the same kind. Proper names (`race.*`, `names.*`, `tech.field.*.name`, `tech.app.*.name`, `ldr.*.name`) cannot be overridden and are not listed.

In a message, `{name}` is an argument. `\n` is a line break.

## desc.tech

295 proper-name keys of this file are not listed.

| Key | Message | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `tech.app.0.desc` | `Placeholder entry that stands for no technology at all.` |  |
| `tech.app.1.desc` | `A targeting system that ignores the target's armor and makes hits against enemy weapons and shield generators {mult, number} times as likely.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.10.desc` | `An orbital bomb of great yield, made to wipe out ground forces and colony buildings. Every bomb causes {min, number} to {max, number} damage.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.100.desc` | `Highly focused coherent light that deals {min, number} to {max, number} damage. Mods: armor piercing, autofire, continuous, heavy mount, no range dissipation, point defense.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.101.desc` | `A hand-held rifle that gives militia, troops and armor units a bonus of {bonus, number} to their fighting rating. Rifle bonuses do not add together.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.102.desc` | `An energy field around a ship that overloads the guidance of incoming missiles, torpedoes and fighters; each has a {pct, number}% chance of being destroyed before dealing damage.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.103.desc` | `Marines are drilled here to repel invasions. The colony starts with {start, number} units and gains {grow, number} per {turns, number} turns until population is at its limit. Imperium, Dictatorship, Confederation and Feudal governments see morale go up {morale, number}%.` | `grow` (number), `morale` (number), `start` (number), `turns` (number) |
| `tech.app.104.desc` | `A rail gun that fires a hyper-velocity slug for {damage, number} damage. Range does not reduce the damage. Mods: armor piercing, autofire, heavy mount, point defense.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.105.desc` | `A pure energy bolt that always finds its target and does {damage, number} damage, though like most beams it loses strength over distance. Mods: heavy mount.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.106.desc` | `Carries a powerful chemical warhead that delivers {damage, number} damage. Mods: MIRV, emissions guidance, fast, armored, ECCM.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.107.desc` | `Engineered microbes that produce medicines. Colonies everywhere grow {growth, number}% faster, and death spores and blight bombs are {cut, number}% less likely to kill colonists.` | `cut` (number), `growth` (number) |
| `tech.app.108.desc` | `Nano-machines build structures and ships from less metal at the same strength. Every worker produces +{prod, number} production.` | `prod` (number) |
| `tech.app.109.desc` | `Starts an outpost on any planet without inhabitants. An outpost acts as a colony but cannot receive population. Outpost ships have no weapons and are lost if attacked without military cover.` |  |
| `tech.app.11.desc` | `Propulsion rated at {speed, number} parsecs each turn. The moment it is discovered, all existing ship drives are refitted to it.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.110.desc` | `Controls the firing of every weapon on a ship for a {hit, number}% to-hit improvement. If the computer is lost, so is the improvement.` | `hit` (number) |
| `tech.app.111.desc` | `Jams every frequency across the spectrum, which raises the ship's missile evasion rating by {evade, number}.` | `evade` (number) |
| `tech.app.112.desc` | `Shield frequencies can be switched at speed, making shields {pct, number}% stronger at maximum.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.113.desc` | `Tiny machines that decompose contaminants in the environment. A planet can make {mult, number} times the production before pollution sets in.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.114.desc` | `Improved data handling allows the brain's pathways to be charted and analyzed, giving spies a nearly flawless lie detector. Spy rolls improve by +{bonus, number}.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.115.desc` | `Shoots an intense stream of deadly radiation, {min, number} to {max, number} damage against shields. One marine unit is killed per {internal, number} points of damage that pass the shields and reach the interior. Mods: continuous, heavy mount.` | `internal` (number), `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.116.desc` | `Spots enemy ships within {range, number} parsecs, with {perSize, number} extra parsec per size class for ships in transit. Targets suffer {evade, number} to missile evasion.` | `evade` (number), `perSize` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.117.desc` | `Armor plating that multiplies a ship's base armor and structure points, and the hit points of its fighters, by {mult, number}. Ground troops gain +{ground, number} combat strength.` | `ground` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.118.desc` | `An orbital bomb that wrecks ground forces and colony buildings, dealing {min, number} to {max, number} damage.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.119.desc` | `An orbital bomb that wrecks ground forces and colony buildings, dealing {min, number} to {max, number} damage.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.12.desc` | `Antimatter spheres that detonate on impact. They fly at speed {speed, number}, deal {damage, number} damage and are launched once every {every, number} turns. Mods: ECCM, enveloping, overloaded.` | `damage` (number), `every` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.120.desc` | `The earliest propulsion that allows travel between stars, rated at {speed, number} parsecs each turn.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.121.desc` | `A nuclear warhead of high yield, {damage, number} damage. Mods: ECCM, emissions guidance, fast, heavily armored, MIRV.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.122.desc` | `Guides every weapon of a ship, improving the to-hit chance by {hit, number}. Without the computer, the improvement is gone.` | `hit` (number) |
| `tech.app.123.desc` | `A focused beam of matter and energy that pierces shields by nature and deals {min, number} to {max, number} damage. Mods: continuous, heavy mount, point defense.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.124.desc` | `Turns aside both kinetic and energy attacks. Militia, troops and armor units get {bonus, number} extra combat rating.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.125.desc` | `A variant of the subspace teleporter. The ship carrying it can transport itself or a different ship as far as {range, number} squares during battle.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.126.desc` | `The ship briefly steps into a different dimension rather than just going out of sight. Phased, it can neither be seen nor attacked. The effect lasts {turns, number} turns, then it turns into a normal cloaking device.` | `turns` (number) |
| `tech.app.127.desc` | `Phased energy that exists in many dimensions together, fired as a trans-warp ray for {min, number} to {max, number} damage. Mods: shield piercing, point defense, heavy mount, continuous, autofire.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.128.desc` | `A rifle that all but vaporizes its target in one shot. Militia, troops and armor units get {bonus, number} extra combat rating; rifle bonuses do not add together.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.129.desc` | `Wraps the planet in an energy shield. Radiated terrain is turned into Barren, attack damage is lowered by {reduce, number}, and invading troops and bioweapons are blocked.` | `reduce` (number) |
| `tech.app.13.desc` | `Anti-missile rocket; missiles are its only valid targets. Reach: {range, number} squares. It shoots at approaching missiles whenever it has not yet fired this turn, with a hit chance of {near, number}% close by that falls to {far, number}% at full reach.` | `far` (number), `near` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.130.desc` | `Wraps the planet in an energy shield. Radiated terrain is turned into Barren and attack damage is lowered by {reduce, number}. Supersedes any planetary radiation shield on the planet.` | `reduce` (number) |
| `tech.app.131.desc` | `Artificial gravity brings a planet to normal gravity, so neither light nor heavy gravity causes problems.` |  |
| `tech.app.132.desc` | `Stocked with your best missiles, {space, number} space units worth, and never runs out of ammunition.` | `space` (number) |
| `tech.app.133.desc` | `A fixed ground battery with {space, number} space units of the best beam weapons, in heavy mount and point defense form.` | `space` (number) |
| `tech.app.134.desc` | `Blocks sunlight and cosmic radiation so living things can walk the surface in comfort. Radiated terrain is turned into Barren, and attack damage on the planet is lowered by {reduce, number}.` | `reduce` (number) |
| `tech.app.135.desc` | `Planet revenue goes up by {pct, number}%.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.136.desc` | `Gives scientists a huge data archive: {rp, number} research points, plus +{perSci, number} research from every scientist.` | `perSci` (number), `rp` (number) |
| `tech.app.137.desc` | `A plasma burst doing {min, number} to {max, number} damage to each of the target's {layers, number} shield facings. It is hard to aim beyond close range: its range penalty to hit is {mult, number} times as heavy. Mods: continuous, heavy mount.` | `layers` (number), `max` (number), `min` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.138.desc` | `The best hand weapon. Militia, troops and armor units get {bonus, number} extra combat rating. Rifle bonuses do not add together.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.139.desc` | `Plasma warhead with {damage, number} damage. Combat speed {speed, number}; it loses {loss, number} strength per square crossed and fires once in {every, number} turns. Mods: ECCM, enveloping, no range dissipation, overloaded.` | `damage` (number), `every` (number), `loss` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.14.desc` | `Raises tank battalions, starting at {start, number} units and gaining {grow, number} every {turns, number} turns, capped at {pct, number}% of the planet's population. Imperium, Dictatorship, Confederation and Feudal governments see morale go up {morale, number}%.` | `grow` (number), `morale` (number), `pct` (number), `start` (number), `turns` (number) |
| `tech.app.140.desc` | `A web of energy that wraps a target up to {range, number} squares away, doing {min, number} to {max, number} damage each turn. The damage stays on the target and decays by {fade, number} per turn.` | `fade` (number), `max` (number), `min` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.141.desc` | `Total sensory immersion through holographic entertainment. Morale goes up {morale, number}%, adding to the holo simulator.` | `morale` (number) |
| `tech.app.142.desc` | `Treats factory waste with advanced chemicals. Only {pct, number}% of the planet's actual production counts toward pollution.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.143.desc` | `Aims all beam weapons of the ship for a {hit, number}% to-hit improvement. Damage to the computer, or its loss, removes the improvement.` | `hit` (number) |
| `tech.app.144.desc` | `Mechanical suits multiply a trooper's natural strength. Troops in powered armor get {bonus, number} combat rating and can take {hits, number} more hit before dying.` | `bonus` (number), `hits` (number) |
| `tech.app.145.desc` | `A personal firearm shooting fast projectiles.` |  |
| `tech.app.146.desc` | `Energy shots at trans-warp speed that strike the same turn they are fired for {damage, number} damage. One shot every {every, number} turns, reaching up to {range, number} squares. Mods: ECCM, enveloping, overloaded.` | `damage` (number), `every` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.147.desc` | `Lets you create psychic beings of great power. Spy rolls gain +{spy, number}. Morale on planets rises by {morale, number}% under Imperium, Dictatorship, Confederation and Feudal governments.` | `morale` (number), `spy` (number) |
| `tech.app.148.desc` | `Every time it fires, vibrations shake nearby ships, missiles and fighters beside the carrier for {min, number} to {max, number} damage, multiplied by the victim's size class.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.149.desc` | `A high-energy pulse warhead for {damage, number} damage. Mods: ECCM, emissions guidance, fast, armored, MIRV.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.15.desc` | `A web of mines around the system. The chance that a ship is hit depends on its hull class: {colossus, number}% for a colossus, {titan, number}% for a titan, {battleship, number}% for a battleship, {cruiser, number}% for a cruiser, {destroyer, number}% for a destroyer and {frigate, number}% for a frigate. A hit deals {min, number} to {max, number} damage, less shields.` | `battleship` (number), `colossus` (number), `cruiser` (number), `destroyer` (number), `frigate` (number), `max` (number), `min` (number), `titan` (number) |
| `tech.app.150.desc` | `On destruction or self-destruction, an interphase reaction makes the explosion {mult, number} times as powerful. Should the ship be captured, it blows itself up {chance, number}% of the time.` | `chance` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.151.desc` | `Offsets inaccurate aim at long distance. When working out to-hit bonuses (and only then), actual distance is divided by {div, number}.` | `div` (number) |
| `tech.app.152.desc` | `Recycling of scrap material brings construction costs down. Each population unit contributes +{prod, number} production, which adds nothing to the planet's pollution.` | `prod` (number) |
| `tech.app.153.desc` | `Beam attacks are bounced back by a subspace field to the attacker. The reflection chance equals the field strength ({strength, number}) over the total of attack damage and field strength.` | `strength` (number) |
| `tech.app.154.desc` | `Builds mechanical workers whose output depends on the minerals of the colony. The production they add is {ultraPoor, number} on ultra-poor worlds, {poor, number} on poor, {abundant, number} on abundant, {rich, number} on rich and {ultraRich, number} on ultra-rich ones.` | `abundant` (number), `poor` (number), `rich` (number), `ultraPoor` (number), `ultraRich` (number) |
| `tech.app.155.desc` | `Houses top computer equipment for superior research. It yields {rp, number} research points and adds +{perSci, number} to each scientist's research.` | `perSci` (number), `rp` (number) |
| `tech.app.156.desc` | `Automates many hard tasks, which makes industrial workers more productive. It yields {prod, number} production and adds +{perWorker, number} per worker.` | `perWorker` (number), `prod` (number) |
| `tech.app.157.desc` | `Spots enemy ships within {range, plural, one {# parsec} other {# parsecs}}. Ships in transit are visible {perSize, plural, one {# parsec} other {# parsecs}} further out for each of their size classes.` | `perSize` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.158.desc` | `A lab run by computers. Research by hull class, frigate to colossus: {frigate, number}, {destroyer, number}, {cruiser, number}, {battleship, number}, {titan, number}, {colossus, number}. In fights against space monsters or the Vaelori, every ship of the fleet gains +{bonus, number} beam attack.` | `battleship` (number), `bonus` (number), `colossus` (number), `cruiser` (number), `destroyer` (number), `frigate` (number), `titan` (number) |
| `tech.app.159.desc` | `Computers watch over critical areas of the ship and use automated weapons against boarders. Marines defending against boarding get +{bonus, number} on combat rolls.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.16.desc` | `Where a system contains an asteroid belt or gas giant, the colony can convert it into a fully artificial, habitable world.` |  |
| `tech.app.160.desc` | `Spots enemy ships within {range, number} parsecs. Ships in transit are visible {perSize, plural, one {# parsec} other {# parsecs}} further out for each of their size classes. Targets suffer {evade, number} to missile evasion.` | `evade` (number), `perSize` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.161.desc` | `Shields refill faster: each turn they regain a further {pct, number}% of their top strength.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.162.desc` | `Nano-machines enrich and fertilize the soil of a planet, so each farmer harvests +{food, number} food. It does not work on Barren, Radiated or Toxic planets.` | `food` (number) |
| `tech.app.163.desc` | `Crews trained here begin with a starting level raised by {level, number}. Ships kept in the system earn {xp, number} experience points per turn.` | `level` (number), `xp` (number) |
| `tech.app.164.desc` | `A marketplace that lifts a colony's money output by {pct, number}%.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.165.desc` | `A sudden warp of subspace around the equipped ship, out to {radius, number} squares. Every object in range takes {min, number} to {max, number} structural hits per size class, shields notwithstanding.` | `max` (number), `min` (number), `radius` (number) |
| `tech.app.166.desc` | `Trains agents. Keep them at home to counter enemy espionage, or send them abroad to take technology and sabotage enemy installations.` |  |
| `tech.app.167.desc` | `Fuel store good for {range, number} parsecs of flight between refuelings.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.168.desc` | `A fortified station for supporting warships. It carries heavy weapons, the best scanner you have (+{scan, number} scan range) and a star dock that builds anything larger than a destroyer.` | `scan` (number) |
| `tech.app.169.desc` | `A big military platform with scan range +{scan, number} parsecs. Ships fighting in its vicinity get +{pct, number}% offense and defense. Supersedes battlestations and star bases.` | `pct` (number), `scan` (number) |
| `tech.app.17.desc` | `{count, number} shuttles in a wing, each moving {marines, number} marine unit from the launching ship to an enemy ship. A shuttle can take {hits, number} hits (changed by the best armor you have) and has speed {speed, number}, more with better drives.` | `count` (number), `hits` (number), `marines` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.170.desc` | `Lets ships move instantly between any two of your colonies. Once researched, every colony gets a gate automatically.` |  |
| `tech.app.171.desc` | `Holds the target motionless in time. A frozen ship has no firing, weapon recharge or cloaking, and nothing can attack it. The field covers {range, number} squares and lasts until it is shut down or destroyed.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.172.desc` | `Dampens the gravitic emissions of faster-than-light drives, so ships fitted with it stay off the main screen at every range.` |  |
| `tech.app.173.desc` | `Makes the wearer almost invisible by blending into the surroundings. All spy rolls gain +{bonus, number}.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.174.desc` | `A plasma cannon for ships or planets. Against every ship, whatever the range and defense, it automatically scores {hits, number} hits on all shields, and an orbital bombardment with it destroys a planet entirely.` | `hits` (number) |
| `tech.app.175.desc` | `Connects to the ship's weapons to locate vulnerable armor on the target. Damage that gets past its shields is multiplied by {mult, number}.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.176.desc` | `Extends your orders to ships up to {range, number} squares from a system with a star base, battlestation or star fortress; such bases give +{cp, number} command points.` | `cp` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.177.desc` | `Lets a ship make a hyperspace jump of at most {range, number} squares. Its heading stays the same after the jump, so turning still takes the normal effort.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.178.desc` | `Automated farms in underground caverns give the planet +{food, number} food.` | `food` (number) |
| `tech.app.179.desc` | `Legendary officers are kept in suspended animation if their ship is lost. They are rescued only if some friendly ship survives the battle.` |  |
| `tech.app.18.desc` | `State-of-the-art instruction makes farmers, workers and scientists more productive; everyone gets +{bonus, number}.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.180.desc` | `Found in star fortresses, battlestations and star bases, these systems send signals through hyperspace so that your orders reach ships up to {range, number} parsecs away. The bases provide +{cp, number} command points.` | `cp` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.181.desc` | `Spots enemy ships within {range, number} parsecs. Ships in transit are visible {perSize, plural, one {# parsec} other {# parsecs}} further out for each of their size classes. Targets suffer {evade, number} to missile evasion.` | `evade` (number), `perSize` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.182.desc` | `Brings out the abilities of the telepaths among your people, creating a police force that can find the truth by new means. Spy rolls improve by {bonus, number}.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.183.desc` | `Improves a planet's habitability: Barren to Desert or Tundra, Desert to Arid, Tundra to Swamp, and Ocean, Swamp and Arid to Terran. Repeat use on a planet adds {cost, number} to the production cost each time.` | `cost` (number) |
| `tech.app.184.desc` | `A fuel system that renews itself and gives all ships endless range.` |  |
| `tech.app.185.desc` | `Lets a ship slip in and out of normal space-time, giving it a bonus turn after each combat turn.` |  |
| `tech.app.186.desc` | `Titans dwarf every other hull, and building them, with all their systems, takes advanced engineering.` |  |
| `tech.app.187.desc` | `The ordinary armor plating of a ship.` |  |
| `tech.app.188.desc` | `For each size class of the target, {per, plural, one {# tractor beam is} other {# tractor beams are}} needed to stop it completely. A target that is not fully held loses part of its movement. A motionless ship can be boarded and is easy to hit.` | `per` (number) |
| `tech.app.189.desc` | `Carries {marines, number} marine units to a planet. Unarmed; lost if attacked without military cover; scrapped after one use. Built only at planets with marine barracks.` | `marines` (number) |
| `tech.app.19.desc` | `Strips many hazardous particles out of a planet's air. Output is cut to a fraction (divided by {div, number}) before the pollution figure is computed. Works together with a pollution processor.` | `div` (number) |
| `tech.app.190.desc` | `Beams marines to an enemy ship {range, number} squares away, if the shield facing it is down. Also drops bombs on planets from that distance.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.191.desc` | `Armor plating that multiplies a ship's base armor and structure points, and the hit points of its fighters, by {mult, number}. Ground troops gain +{ground, number} combat strength.` | `ground` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.192.desc` | `More detachments of space marines: the ship's marines are multiplied by {mult, number}. The extra marines can protect the ship or storm enemy ones.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.193.desc` | `Colonies everywhere grow {growth, number}% faster and are {cut, number}% less exposed to death spores and blight bombs. Cannot be combined with microbiotics.` | `cut` (number), `growth` (number) |
| `tech.app.194.desc` | `Fuel store good for {range, number} parsecs of flight between refuelings.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.195.desc` | `Connects the entire galaxy by cyberspace so people can visit other realities. Empire-wide morale goes up {morale, number}%.` | `morale` (number) |
| `tech.app.196.desc` | `A wide zone around the ship where no ship can enter hyperspace; enemies cannot flee while it operates.` |  |
| `tech.app.197.desc` | `A warp-disrupting field around the system where it stands. Out to {radius, number} parsecs, enemy ships move at {speed, plural, one {# parsec} other {# parsecs}} per turn at most.` | `radius` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.198.desc` | `Adjusts the weather of a planet for steadier farming. Food production rises by +{food, number} per farmer.` | `food` (number) |
| `tech.app.199.desc` | `Boosts the ship's missile evasion by {own, number}, and that of every other ship in the fleet by {fleet, number}. Fleet bonuses from several jammers do not add up; the highest counts.` | `fleet` (number), `own` (number) |
| `tech.app.2.desc` | `Armor plating that multiplies a ship's base armor and structure points, and the hit points of its fighters, by {mult, number}. Ground troops gain +{ground, number} combat strength.` | `ground` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.20.desc` | `Combat speed of the ship goes up by +{speed, number}.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.200.desc` | `Studies the motives of other races to craft deals that appeal to them. Every deal you offer an opponent permanently gains +{points, number} diplomatic points.` | `points` (number) |
| `tech.app.201.desc` | `Armor plating that multiplies a ship's base armor and structure points, and the hit points of its fighters, by {mult, number}. Ground troops gain +{ground, number} combat strength.` | `ground` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.202.desc` | `A high-explosive warhead for {damage, number} damage. Mods: ECCM, emissions guidance, fast, armored, MIRV.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.203.desc` | `Armor plating that multiplies a ship's base armor and structure points, and the hit points of its fighters, by {mult, number}. Ground troops gain +{ground, number} combat strength.` | `ground` (number), `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.204.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every genetics application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.205.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every power application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.206.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every physics application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.207.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every construction application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.208.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every fields application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.209.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every chemistry application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.21.desc` | `Fully automatic research station producing {rp, number} research points.` | `rp` (number) |
| `tech.app.210.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every computer application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.211.desc` | `Breakthroughs in this field shrink every sociology application further, and are worth {score, number} score points.` | `score` (number) |
| `tech.app.22.desc` | `Machines that help industrial workers make finished goods. The building yields {prod, number} production and adds +{perWorker, number} to what each worker produces.` | `perWorker` (number), `prod` (number) |
| `tech.app.23.desc` | `Mends the ship while the battle rages: each combat turn it regains {armorPct, number}% of its armor or structure plus {sysPct, number}% of its internal systems. Once the battle is over, all damage is repaired.` | `armorPct` (number), `sysPct` (number) |
| `tech.app.24.desc` | `Huge combat robots that beat standard tanks for strength and speed. Each gives +{bonus, number} combat rating and absorbs {hits, number} hits.` | `bonus` (number), `hits` (number) |
| `tech.app.25.desc` | `With battle pods a hull offers {pct, number}% extra space.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.26.desc` | `Beam weapons become {hit, number}% more likely to hit, and the galactic scanner reaches {range, number} parsecs farther.` | `hit` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.27.desc` | `A well-armed base whose scanners reach +{scan, number} parsecs further. Ships battling nearby gain +{offense, number}% offense. Takes the place of a star base.` | `offense` (number), `scan` (number) |
| `tech.app.28.desc` | `The deadliest bioweapon yet devised: each strike has a {chance, number}% chance of killing {kill, number} million colonists. Every other race takes a severe diplomatic dislike to its use.` | `chance` (number), `kill` (number) |
| `tech.app.29.desc` | `Edible plants that thrive anywhere. Every farmer on every planet produces +{food, number} food, even on worlds with no base food output.` | `food` (number) |
| `tech.app.3.desc` | `Careful advance planning of new settlements lets every planet in the empire hold {pop, number} million more colonists.` | `pop` (number) |
| `tech.app.30.desc` | `Opens an artificial black hole around the target ship, pinning it in place with intense gravity. Within {turns, number} turns, either the generator or its carrier must be destroyed, or the target is lost.` | `turns` (number) |
| `tech.app.31.desc` | `Small craft with one bomb apiece, the best type you have, either dropped on a planet or exploded at a ship. They travel in groups of {group, number} at speed {speed, number}, more with better drives.` | `group` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.32.desc` | `The seat of the empire's government, needed to keep order. If the colony that holds it is lost, the consequences depend on the form of government. A destroyed capitol may be rebuilt, but it cannot be constructed in any other case.` |  |
| `tech.app.33.desc` | `Shield that guards a ship against physical and energy attacks. Each incoming hit is weakened by {reduce, number}. How much damage it soaks up before it collapses grows with the class and the size of the hull, and it recovers {regen, number}% every combat turn.` | `reduce` (number), `regen` (number) |
| `tech.app.34.desc` | `Shield that guards a ship against physical and energy attacks. Each incoming hit is weakened by {reduce, number}. How much damage it soaks up before it collapses grows with the class and the size of the hull, and it recovers {regen, number}% every combat turn.` | `reduce` (number), `regen` (number) |
| `tech.app.35.desc` | `Shield that guards a ship against physical and energy attacks. Each incoming hit is weakened by {reduce, number}. How much damage it soaks up before it collapses grows with the class and the size of the hull, and it recovers {regen, number}% every combat turn.` | `reduce` (number), `regen` (number) |
| `tech.app.36.desc` | `Shield that guards a ship against physical and energy attacks. Each incoming hit is weakened by {reduce, number}. How much damage it soaks up before it collapses grows with the class and the size of the hull, and it recovers {regen, number}% every combat turn.` | `reduce` (number), `regen` (number) |
| `tech.app.37.desc` | `Shield that guards a ship against physical and energy attacks. Each incoming hit is weakened by {reduce, number}. How much damage it soaks up before it collapses grows with the class and the size of the hull, and it recovers {regen, number}% every combat turn.` | `reduce` (number), `regen` (number) |
| `tech.app.38.desc` | `Conceals a ship completely from long-range sensors. In battle the ship gains +{beamDef, number} beam defense, and missiles miss it {miss, number}% of the time while it holds fire. After firing it needs a quiet turn before it can cloak again.` | `beamDef` (number), `miss` (number) |
| `tech.app.39.desc` | `Surgeons can swap out worn or injured organs. While a colony is under its population cap it grows faster by {growth, number}K every turn.` | `growth` (number) |
| `tech.app.4.desc` | `Every ship is fully repaired after a battle. The ability is built into all ships as soon as it is researched.` |  |
| `tech.app.40.desc` | `Establishes a colony on a different planet of the same star. The new colony is built by the one using this.` |  |
| `tech.app.41.desc` | `Can found a colony in a faraway system. It never fights; if attacked it is destroyed unless a warship escorts it.` |  |
| `tech.app.42.desc` | `The feudal system scaled up to the whole galaxy. Enemy empires can no longer absorb your colonies, and starship construction costs are divided by {den, number}.` | `den` (number) |
| `tech.app.43.desc` | `A link between mind and machine lets spies slip past many computerized safeguards. Spy rolls improve by +{bonus, number}.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.44.desc` | `A neural-net computer that learns as it works, similar to a living brain. Fitted to every ship, it improves beam to-hit by {hit, number}%, though the improvement disappears if the computer is hurt or destroyed.` | `hit` (number) |
| `tech.app.45.desc` | `Wraps a ship in a field that cuts the damage it takes by {cut, number}%. It scrambles transporter beams too: of the marines beamed aboard, only {num, number} in {den, number} arrive.` | `cut` (number), `den` (number), `num` (number) |
| `tech.app.46.desc` | `Missiles and torpedoes learn to tell friend from foe. If the target dies, they head for the closest enemy ship.` |  |
| `tech.app.47.desc` | `Fires a cosmic ray beam for {min, number} to {max, number} damage. A marine unit dies for every {internal, number} points that get through the shields to the interior. Mods: continuous, heavy mount.` | `internal` (number), `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.48.desc` | `Engineered organisms that attack living things, released by bombardment. A launch kills {kill, number} million colonists, with {chance, number}% probability. All other races take a strong diplomatic dislike to the use of bioweapons.` | `chance` (number), `kill` (number) |
| `tech.app.49.desc` | `Lets miners dig stable shafts deep below the surface. The building yields {prod, number} production and adds +{perWorker, number} production per worker.` | `perWorker` (number), `prod` (number) |
| `tech.app.5.desc` | `Better handling of conquered alien populations: they assimilate {speed, number} times as quickly, labor more diligently, and the odds of an uprising fall by {revolt, number}%.` | `revolt` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.50.desc` | `Stores man-made toxic waste far below the surface, away from groundwater. The planet's pollution is removed completely.` |  |
| `tech.app.51.desc` | `An energy store that lets a ship travel as far as {range, number} parsecs without refueling.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.52.desc` | `A gateway to Vaelor, the Vaelori home dimension. To enter, send a fleet to the portal's own star and use the Attack Vaelori command in the fleet pop-up.` |  |
| `tech.app.53.desc` | `Every weapon aimed at the equipped ship has a {miss, number}% chance to miss outright, whatever else applies.` | `miss` (number) |
| `tech.app.54.desc` | `Fires intense energy bolts for {damage, number} damage that range does not reduce. Mods: autofire, heavy mount.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.55.desc` | `Mobile planetoid bases, the biggest hulls you can build.` |  |
| `tech.app.56.desc` | `Multiplies a ship's structure by {mult, number} and protects its drive better, so {mult, number} times as much damage is needed to destroy it.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.57.desc` | `A pulse of magnetism that fouls weapon tracking and missile guidance alike, giving the ship +{evade, number}% missile evasion.` | `evade` (number) |
| `tech.app.58.desc` | `Aims the weapons of a starship. Every ship is fitted with the best one you know; this one improves hit chance by {hit, number}%. Damage to the computer, or its destruction, removes that bonus.` | `hit` (number) |
| `tech.app.59.desc` | `Follows the warp trail of its target. When it breaks through the shields, its whole damage goes into the drive, ignoring armor. The price: each missile needs {mult, number} times the normal space and cost.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.6.desc` | `Robot farmhands, each adding +{food, number} food. Their upkeep is {upkeep, number} production per turn rather than food. Morale, racial traits and wages do not apply to them.` | `food` (number), `upkeep` (number) |
| `tech.app.60.desc` | `A share of incoming damage ({pct, number}%) is diverted into the absorber. The stored energy must be fired at an enemy during the ship's next turn, or it is wasted.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.61.desc` | `Lets a colony control its environment so that hostile parts of the planet can be settled. The planet's maximum population rises by {pop, number} million.` | `pop` (number) |
| `tech.app.62.desc` | `Changes the makeup of your race. After the research is complete you gain {points, number} further race picks, usable to drop disadvantages or to boost advantages.` | `points` (number) |
| `tech.app.63.desc` | `Ships can travel {pct, number}% further, though the tanks eat up much of the hull space.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.64.desc` | `Lets a ship fire {volleys, number} missile volleys in a single turn. After that it can fire only one per turn until it spends a full turn without missile fire to reload.` | `volleys` (number) |
| `tech.app.65.desc` | `The more developed Democracy: its research and income bonus becomes +{bonus, number}%.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.66.desc` | `A single wing of {count, number} short-range fighters fits aboard. Each has one beam weapon, the best type that supports point defense, with {shots, number} shots before it docks again.` | `count` (number), `shots` (number) |
| `tech.app.67.desc` | `A planetary base housing {interceptors, number} interceptors. When the matching technology is known it fields squadrons of {bombers, number} bombers or {heavy, number} heavy fighters instead. New fighters appear every {turns, number} combat turns.` | `bombers` (number), `heavy` (number), `interceptors` (number), `turns` (number) |
| `tech.app.68.desc` | `Turns lifeless matter into edible food. On demand, the facility turns {prod, number} units of production into {food, number} unit of food for the colony.` | `food` (number), `prod` (number) |
| `tech.app.69.desc` | `Cargo ships that shuttle food or colonists between worlds. A fleet is {ships, number} freighters and moves {food, number} food, or {pop, number} population unit, every turn.` | `food` (number), `pop` (number), `ships` (number) |
| `tech.app.7.desc` | `Robot lab assistants, each yielding {rp, number} research points every turn. Their upkeep is {upkeep, number} production per turn rather than food. Morale, racial traits and wages do not apply to them.` | `rp` (number), `upkeep` (number) |
| `tech.app.70.desc` | `Fires a beam of charged particles that deals {min, number} to {max, number} damage. Available mods: enveloping, continuous, point defense and heavy mount.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.71.desc` | `An orbital bomb that wrecks ground forces and colony buildings, dealing {min, number} to {max, number} damage.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.72.desc` | `Allows faster-than-light flight at {speed, number} parsecs per turn. Drives already installed are upgraded automatically.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.73.desc` | `A heavy-duty personal rifle that gives militia, troops and armor units a bonus of {bonus, number} to their fighting rating. Rifle bonuses do not add together.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.74.desc` | `Seeds a planet with engineered microbes so that plants and animals can both thrive there. Terran planets only.` |  |
| `tech.app.75.desc` | `Replaces hard currency with instant electronic exchange and raises the money produced by every colony by {pct, number}%.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.76.desc` | `Near-instant communication across the galaxy lets ideas travel quickly. The cybernet yields {rp, number} research points, and every scientist produces +{perSci, number} research.` | `perSci` (number), `rp` (number) |
| `tech.app.77.desc` | `Joins every member of the race into one shared mind that works in perfect harmony, boosting farmer and worker output by {pct, number}%. Available solely to races whose start included unification.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.78.desc` | `A very powerful linear accelerator doing {damage, number} damage no matter the range. Mods: autofire, armor piercing, heavy mount.` | `damage` (number) |
| `tech.app.79.desc` | `Waves of gravity rip the target apart for {min, number} to {max, number} damage. Whatever passes the shields also does extra structural damage. Mods: heavy mount, continuous.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.8.desc` | `Robot assembly hands, each adding +{prod, number} production. Their upkeep is {upkeep, number} production per turn rather than food. Morale, racial traits and wages do not apply to them.` | `prod` (number), `upkeep` (number) |
| `tech.app.80.desc` | `A sudden rupture in the subspace field around a ship shakes its inertial dampers and sends it spinning. Damage is {min, number} to {max, number} structure points per size class of the target, at up to {range, number} squares.` | `max` (number), `min` (number), `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.81.desc` | `Each attack does {reduce, number} less damage on top of the usual shield effect. Shields stay up inside a nebula, enemy transporters are blocked even once shields are lowered, and shield-piercing weapons do nothing.` | `reduce` (number) |
| `tech.app.82.desc` | `Heavy plating that overrides armor piercing and makes a ship's armor take {mult, number} times as much damage before failing.` | `mult` (number) |
| `tech.app.83.desc` | `Heavy fighters, each armed with {beams, number} point-defense beams (best type known) and {bombs, number} of the best available bombs. Armor and speed: {hits, number} hits to destroy, adjusted by your top armor, and speed {speed, number}, more with better drives.` | `beams` (number), `bombs` (number), `hits` (number), `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.84.desc` | `Gene work lifts the intelligence of the entire population, so each scientist adds +{rp, number} to research.` | `rp` (number) |
| `tech.app.85.desc` | `Concentrates energy weapon fire so it hits harder: damage goes up {pct, number}% of base at every range. Accuracy against faraway targets is unchanged.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.86.desc` | `Projects lifelike three-dimensional images that raise the morale of the planet by {morale, number}%.` | `morale` (number) |
| `tech.app.87.desc` | `A sealed, automatic environment that grows food even on lifeless worlds, adding +{food, number} food to the planet's output.` | `food` (number) |
| `tech.app.88.desc` | `Engines good for {speed, number} parsecs per turn. Discovering it upgrades every drive you already have.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.89.desc` | `Carry and amplify energy in less space, leaving more room for equipment: a ship can hold {pct, number}% more. They are fitted to every ship automatically once acquired.` | `pct` (number) |
| `tech.app.9.desc` | `Lets ground troops and armor units fly, which makes them more mobile and harder to hit. Their ground combat rating rises by {bonus, number}.` | `bonus` (number) |
| `tech.app.90.desc` | `Beam weapons get {shots, number} shots in a turn. Afterwards the weapons must rest for one turn; failing that, they fire only once per turn.` | `shots` (number) |
| `tech.app.91.desc` | `Reach any ship that is in hyperspace and redirect it. Star bases, battlestations and fortresses gain +{cp, number} command points.` | `cp` (number) |
| `tech.app.92.desc` | `The refined Dictatorship: all command points produced go up {cpPct, number}%, and defensive spy rolls improve by {spies, number}.` | `cpPct` (number), `spies` (number) |
| `tech.app.93.desc` | `A warp bubble that functions in ordinary space, so the ship maneuvers better and is harder to hit. Beam defense +{defense, number}; turning no longer uses movement.` | `defense` (number) |
| `tech.app.94.desc` | `A weaker warp bubble inside ordinary space gives the ship much better handling and makes it far harder to hit: beam defense +{defense, number} and turning costs {cut, number}% less movement.` | `cut` (number), `defense` (number) |
| `tech.app.95.desc` | `Engines good for {speed, number} parsecs per turn. Discovering it upgrades every drive you already have.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.96.desc` | `Engines good for {speed, number} parsecs per turn. Discovering it upgrades every drive you already have.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.app.97.desc` | `A particle wave that disrupts onboard systems for {min, number} to {max, number} damage, ignoring both armor and structure. Monsters and Vaelori ships are unaffected. Mods: autofire, continuous.` | `max` (number), `min` (number) |
| `tech.app.98.desc` | `An energy store that lets a ship travel as far as {range, number} parsecs without refueling.` | `range` (number) |
| `tech.app.99.desc` | `A controlled wormhole linking two points, which adds {speed, number} parsecs per turn to ships that travel through it. Every colony is equipped with a gate automatically once the technology is known.` | `speed` (number) |
| `tech.field.ha.level` | `{field} {numeral}` | `field` (text or number), `numeral` (text or number) |
| `tech.field.ha.title` | `Hyper-advanced {field}` | `field` (text or number) |

## dip.statements

| Key | Message | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `dip.st.acceptAlliance` | `{v, select, 1 {We will be allies, then. Let it be so.} 2 {Gladly. The alliance is sealed.} other {Allies at last. May it serve us both.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.acceptNap` | `{v, select, 1 {We agree to a pact of non-aggression.} 2 {A sensible idea. The pact is signed.} other {Very well. Let there be no fighting between us.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.acceptPeace` | `{v, select, 1 {We accept peace. Let the fighting end.} 2 {Peace, then. May it last.} other {Enough war. Peace is agreed.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.acceptResearch` | `{v, select, 1 {We will share research with you, as you ask.} other {Agreed. Our scientists will work together.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.acceptSweetened` | `{v, select, 1 {With the {gift} you offer, we agree.} 2 {The {gift} sweetens the deal. We accept.} other {A gift of {gift} is persuasive. Done.}}` | `gift` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.acceptTrade` | `{v, select, 1 {We accept. Trade will begin at once.} 2 {A fair offer. Our merchants will be pleased.} other {Let it be so. The trade pact is agreed.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.allianceEndedRefused` | `You will not stand with us? Then our alliance is over.` |  |
| `dip.st.allianceHonored` | `Thank you for standing with us in this war. The alliance holds.` |  |
| `dip.st.allyGrants` | `{v, select, 1 {For an ally, anything. It will be done.} 2 {You are our ally. Of course we agree.} other {Since we are allies, I will not refuse you.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.amendsBio` | `{v, select, 1 {Your bioweapons demand a price: {offer}. Refuse, and the {treaty} ends.} other {Give us {offer} for the poison you used, or lose the {treaty}.}}` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.amendsBlockade` | `Your blockade must be paid for with {offer}, or our {treaty} is over.` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number) |
| `dip.st.amendsExpansion` | `{v, select, 1 {Your colonies broke our understanding. Give us {offer} to save the {treaty}.} other {We will keep the {treaty} only if you pay {offer} for your expansion.}}` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.amendsFleet` | `{v, select, 1 {Your fleet at {system} must be paid for. We demand {offer}, or the {treaty} is finished.} other {Withdraw from {system} and give us {offer}, and the {treaty} will hold.}}` | `offer` (text or number), `system` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.amendsSabotage` | `{v, select, 1 {For the damage you caused we require {offer}. Otherwise the {treaty} ends.} other {Pay {offer} for your sabotage, or our {treaty} is over.}}` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.amendsSabotageFramed` | `The saboteur may have been framed on you, but we still need {offer} to keep the {treaty}.` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number) |
| `dip.st.amendsTheft` | `{v, select, 1 {For stealing from us, we ask for {offer}. Pay it, and our {treaty} stands.} other {Your theft cost us dearly. Hand over {offer} and we will keep the {treaty}.}}` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.amendsTheftFramed` | `You stole from us, even if you were set up. Give us {offer} to keep the {treaty}.` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number) |
| `dip.st.amendsVote` | `{v, select, 1 {Your vote cannot be undone, but {offer} would mend the {treaty}.} other {Pay {offer} for your vote, or the {treaty} is lost.}}` | `offer` (text or number), `treaty` (text or number), `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.askWar` | `{v, select, 1 {Declare war on the {thirdRace} by year {year}.{tenth} and we will reward you.} 2 {The {thirdRace} are our enemy. Fight them, and you will be paid.} other {We would like to see the {thirdRace} fall. Will you attack them?}}` | `tenth` (text or number), `thirdRace` (text or number), `v` (text), `year` (text or number) |
| `dip.st.audienceEnds` | `{v, select, 1 {That is enough. This audience is over.} 2 {I have heard enough from you. Good day.} other {You have worn out my patience. Leave.}}` | `v` (text) |
| `dip.st.breakWithThird` | `{v, select, 1 {Cut your ties with {thirdLeader} of the {thirdRace}. We do not trust them.} 2 {You cannot be a friend to both of us and {thirdLeader}. Break with the {thirdRace}.} other {Break your treaties with the {thirdRace}, and {thirdLeader} will get what is coming.}}` | `thirdLeader` (text or number), `thirdRace` (text or number), `v` (text) |

| `ui.info.ref.entry.hyperSociology.body` | `A research line that continues after the Sociology branch is complete and can be repeated. Each level finished makes the equipment of that branch one step smaller, and adds to your tech value.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.entry.hyperSociology.title` | `Hyper Sociology` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.howTo` | `How to?` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.assignLeaders.name` | `Assign Leaders` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.assignLeaders.p1` | `Open the Leaders screen. Hire a leader from the pool when one is on offer, then give the leader a post.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.assignLeaders.p2` | `Colony leaders improve a planet; ship officers improve a ship and its fleet. Select a leader and a colony or ship slot to assign. Leaders cost wages every turn and gain levels with experience.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.captureShips.name` | `Capture Ships` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.captureShips.p1` | `A ship that carries marines or troop pods can take an enemy ship by boarding. Bring the target's shields down in battle, then order the boarding party across.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.captureShips.p2` | `If the marines win, the ship joins your fleet; if they lose, they are lost. Ships with strong crews and armed defenses are harder to take.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.captureShips.p3` | `Boarding happens only in tactical battles. With Tactical Combat off, battles are resolved automatically and beaten ships are always destroyed, never captured.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.changeTax.name` | `Change Tax Rates` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.changeTax.p1` | `Click the treasury box on the map screen to open the tax window and pick a rate. A higher rate turns more of every colony's production into money and leaves less for building.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.changeTax.p2` | `Taxes do not change morale. The treasury figures follow the new rate at once, and the tax is collected when the turn ends.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.createColonies.name` | `Create New Colonies` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.createColonies.p1` | `Build an Outpost Ship or a Colony Ship on the production list of a colony. Send it to a star that has a free planet and open the colonize window there.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.createColonies.p2` | `An outpost claims the planet and extends your range and supply. A Colony Ship also lands population units, which start to grow at once.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.createColonies.p3` | `Monsters guard some systems and block colonization until they are destroyed.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.curePlague.name` | `Cure a Plague` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.curePlague.p1` | `A plague stops growth on its colony and keeps it under quarantine. It is cured by research.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.curePlague.p2` | `More research output in the colony shortens it, and the Universal Antidote ends it at once. Keep scientists on the plagued planet if you can.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.designShips.name` | `Design Ships` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.designShips.p1` | `Open the production screen of a colony and press DESIGN. Pick a hull size.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.designShips.p2` | `A new design gets the best shield, computer, armor and drive you have. Click a system name to swap it, choose NO WEAPON to drop a weapon, and use the add line to mount another where space allows.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.designShips.p3` | `Press ACCEPT to keep the design, then build it from the same production list. The hull limits space, and every system adds to the cost.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.destroyComet.name` | `Destroy a Comet` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.destroyComet.p1` | `A comet announced by the news will strike one of your colonies after a few turns. Park armed ships in orbit of the target planet.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.destroyComet.p2` | `Every turn the ships wear the comet down by their combined size, and a comet that is destroyed before it arrives does no harm.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.destroyComet.p3` | `A comet that strikes kills part of the people there and damages buildings.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.endPirates.name` | `End Pirate Activity` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.endPirates.p1` | `While pirates are active, trade income is cut and freighters are lost along the routes they haunt.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.endPirates.p2` | `Station warships at your colonies to patrol. The activity ends sooner when the pirates meet armed ships, so keep a fleet near your busiest worlds.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.getHelp.name` | `Get More Help` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.getHelp.p1` | `Right click on almost any control to see what it does. Press the right button again, or CLOSE, to dismiss it.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.getHelp.p2` | `On this console, point at an entry of a category page to read about it. The PLANETS list, the COLONIES list and the Fleets screen answer most questions about what you own.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.goToStar.name` | `Go to {star}` | `star` (text or number) |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.goToStar.p1` | `{star} is the home of the Vaelori, reached only through a Dimensional Portal.` | `star` (text or number) |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.goToStar.p2` | `Find the system of a portal, move a fleet there and use the Attack {star} command in the fleet pop-up. Bring your strongest ships: nothing you meet on the other side is gentle.` | `star` (text or number) |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.invadePlanets.name` | `Invade Planets` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.invadePlanets.p1` | `Load Transports at a colony with Marine Barracks, escort them with warships and fly to the enemy planet.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.invadePlanets.p2` | `Beat down the defenders and the shields first. When the way is clear, order the landing: the troops fight the garrison, and the winner owns the planet.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.invadePlanets.p3` | `Better armor, personal shields and rifles raise the strength of your troops. Do not bomb a planet you want to keep: bombing kills its people.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveColonists.name` | `Move Colonists` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveColonists.p1` | `Population can be shipped between your colonies. Use the transport order of a colony, choose how many units go and pick the destination colony.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveColonists.p2` | `Each colonist on the way needs a free freighter, so build Freighters first. Colonists in transit do not work and do not eat, and they arrive after a few turns.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveColonists.p3` | `Use this to fill planets that have room, or to staff an outpost.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveShips.name` | `Move Ships` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveShips.p1` | `Select a fleet on the map or on the Fleets screen and click a star to set its course. The ETA appears at once.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveShips.p2` | `A fleet moves at the speed of its slowest ship. Ships must stay within fuel range of your colonies, so extend your range with outposts and better fuel cells before you go far.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.moveShips.p3` | `You can split a fleet in the fleet window to send ships to different places.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.pickColonies.name` | `Pick New Colonies` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.pickColonies.p1` | `Each planet has a climate, a size, a gravity and a mineral richness. Check them before you settle.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.pickColonies.p2` | `Terran, Ocean, Swamp, Arid, Tundra, Desert and Gaia worlds can grow food. A hostile world needs better environment research first.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.pickColonies.p3` | `Abundant, Rich and Ultra Rich minerals raise what each worker produces. Heavy or light gravity slows growth, production and research unless your race is built for it.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.pickColonies.p4` | `A planet without farming can still be a fine mine or laboratory if freighters bring it food. The PLANETS list shows the candidates in range.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.preventSupernovas.name` | `Prevent Supernovas` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.preventSupernovas.p1` | `When a star is about to go nova a countdown starts. Put enough research into that system before it ends and the star calms down.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.preventSupernovas.p2` | `If the countdown runs out, every planet of the system is scorched and its colonies are lost. Move scientists there, or raise their output with research buildings.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.refitShips.name` | `Refit Ships` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.refitShips.p1` | `A refit turns ships of an old design into ships of a newer design with the same hull, so you keep the crews and their experience.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topic.refitShips.p2` | `Select the ships on the Fleets screen while they sit in orbit of one of your colonies, press REFIT and choose the new design. The work is paid like any other project of that colony.` |  |
| `ui.info.ref.topicTitle` | `How to: {name}` | `name` (text or number) |

| `ui.modPolicy.s6.head` | `Fit for the game's players` |  |
